title: Nexgrill Ranger 4 Burner BBQ $174.50 (50% off) in Closure Stores Only @ Barbeques Galore
body:
Deal: Nexgrill Ranger 4 Burner BBQ $174.50 (50% off) in Closure Stores Only @ Barbeques Galore

[Phoebus] Looks good for under $200.
Nobody needs more than 4 burners.
[Rkel403] Out of interest , much outdoor furniture still available in store?
[87percent] The one at Chadstone had a couple of benches
[donman92] The working class can only put up with so much cost of living ..there's barely any room to spend money on non necessities.
[Yorkshire-Man] Also they were a rip off. I went in there last week, mainly for nostalgia, they had a pizza oven that was 40% off as a display model. A quick google search showed that a new one direct from the manufacturer was cheaper. That's not a recipe for business success.
[R4] Yes, a strange business model. They sometimes had really good sales (I bought our log burner there at a great price) but generally overpriced. Retailers that remain competitive and/or add some other value will continue to do well - BG is not one of them.
[Hoopzzy] They were sold to a private equity firm and then just recently changed hands. Unfortunately it is far to common.
[JaxSantiago] OP where's the store you bought it from?
[garage sale] was hoping they might have had the Grand Turbo quartz burner bbqs for sale or the quartz burners as spares but not to be.
[AndyC1] Make sure you get some spare burners or you will get burnt trying to find them in a few years.
[Combo64] It's destined landfill. They only make 1 good bbq and thats the turbo elite but no way anyone would be stupid to pay $1500+ on a bbq with no warranty and no parts.
Burners and grills are a must for spares especially after 5 years. The burners are very proprietary on this model.
I would honestly go to Bunnings and just buy a Beefeater BBQ and you'll still get 15 years out of it. Spares can be had from any bbq shop. I got my last Beefeater for $250 from Bunnings.
[RichardF89] all 62 company-owned stores nationwide colsed
[nokidsandthreemoney] So every single store is closing down? Do they have an end date?
[RichardF89] 27 independently operated franchise stores remain open under transitional arrangements.
https://www.barbequesgalore.com.au/stores/franchises.html?sr…

[Sammyboy] Hopefully that means warranties can be honoured. Although they do warn you when purchasing there is no warranty. I purchased a bbq with cart (beef master). The bbq in 1 box, cart was flat packed in another box. The box for the cart looked fine but inside 2 panels had carners squashed in, and the holes for mounting the doors were at these parts. I rang the store and they said nothing they can do, even if they had a spare cart they cant exchange it due to the arrangements with the administrators. They said I had to deal with head office customer service. So far its taken them a week to reply once asking for the serial number, and its been a week since and no further response. I called up too and they said I had to email them.
[Jackson] My parents bought a cast iron coal bbg 36 years ago from them and we cooked on that thing for at least 27 years and took it everywhere. We also bought a Rinnai 3 burner from them which we still have, but it hasn't had use in a long time. I am about to have a go at restoring it or it will end up getting scrapped
[R4] The log burner I bought there nearly 20 years ago is still going strong (used it today) and is as good as new
[DangerNoodle] I've got a Ziggy twin from them that is still running strong after 5 years of daily cooking.
I was looking for a 4 burner griddle but it looks like they've sold out of the beefmaster 4 burners.
I did end up getting a beefmaster premium range stove/wok burner from them from this closing down sale, works really well. Gets the 34cm cast iron chef over 300C a bit too easily.
[Legend279] Saw a few 4 burners on the weekend in Hoppers Crossing, was going to wait another week to see off prices drops.
[Phoebus] for this price I'd expect 6 burners and a 4kw wok burner on the side.
[michael9865] You could get somethimg like this for $150 new before covid as the normal price
[node modules] Nah I already got one after visiting every store in Sydney
